system.description:
Materials: Boiled leather or steel skullcap; metal bracket; candle or small oil lamp.

Physical Description: A sturdy helmet with a specialized bracket riveted to the front, holding a secure socket for a candle or a miniaturized oil lamp. This setup provides a cone of light directly where the wearer looks while leaving both hands completely free for combat, climbing, or mining.

Duration: 1 hour (Candle) / 4 hours (Small Oil Lamp)
